_doc: Per-world overrides for ingame pipeline. worldSizeSource: 'gms' | 'grad_meh'. scaleFactor multiplies GMS world coords into RAMET world coords. offsetEast/offsetNorth shift the in-game raster on the world grid, in metres, north-east positive — leave them out unless a map's export really is offset. GMS's own OriginX/OriginY are a grid-reference origin, not an image offset, and are deliberately ignored.
